description: Script for automatically closing duplicate GitHub issues based on comments and reactions, using GitHub API.

methods.name: githubRequest
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to GitHub API with proper headers and error handling.

methods.name: extractDuplicateIssueNumber
methods.description: Extracts duplicate issue number from comment body using regex patterns.

methods.name: closeIssueAsDuplicate
methods.description: Closes a GitHub issue as a duplicate and posts a comment indicating duplication.

methods.name: autoCloseDuplicates
methods.description: Main function that fetches issues, filters for duplicates, and auto-closes them based on criteria.
